supports.assessment: 肌痛作为待评估副作用支持症状不直接等于严重肌损伤的编辑解释；并非本页明确的量化诊断结论，保留推论边界。
明确区别常见肌痛投诉与极少见严重肌损伤；这里只解释不能用症状替代确诊，不加入风险数值。

text.zh-CN: ACE抑制剂降低血压、减轻心脏泵血负担。
text.en: ACE inhibitors lower blood pressure and reduce the heart’s pumping workload.

supports.assessment: 降血压减轻心脏负担；不独自支持所有安全监測句。
ACE降血压、利于泵血。

text.zh-CN: 可能出现干咳、头晕，或血钾与肾功能变化；
text.en: They can cause dry cough, dizziness or changes in potassium and kidney function;

supports.assessment: 干咳、低压头晕、血钾升高、肾功能恶化。
仅支持雷米普利的干咳/头晕，不支持这一分句的血钾/肾功能部分。
ACEI/ARB开始或加量后可有肌酐及血钾变化，补类级证据；NICE/BNF等共同上游明确。

text.zh-CN: 医生会安排血压和抽血检查。
text.en: clinicians arrange blood-pressure and blood-test monitoring.

supports.assessment: MI后ACEI/ARB用药前后测肾功能、电解质、血压；用本条替换原1.4.2的过宽定位。实际读取官方索引条文，未声称全文PDF访问。
MI专段直接列血压/肌酐或eGFR/钠/钾；独立专业综合但引用NICE共同依据，非独立试验。本文不采用统一复查间隔。

text.zh-CN: 持续影响生活的咳嗽应联系医生讨论调整。
text.en: Discuss a persistent troublesome cough with the prescriber.

supports.assessment: 干咳、低压头晕、血钾升高、肾功能变化；问题应与医护讨论。

ACE类药干咳变得困扰时联系医生，医生可改用另一类药；与NHS-national雷米普利26为不同作者材料。

text.zh-CN: β受体阻滞剂减慢心率、减轻心脏负担，帮助控制某些心律和胸痛问题。
text.en: Beta blockers slow the heart and reduce its workload, helping with some rhythm and chest-pain problems.

supports.assessment: 减心率和血压，减少心肌负担。
β阻滞剂对泵血、心律和胸痛角色。
直接支持减慢心率、减负荷、心律问题及心绞痛，优于仅MI药物摘要296的窄定位。

text.zh-CN: 可能引起疲劳或头晕；
text.en: They can cause tiredness or dizziness;

supports.assessment: 疲劳/头晕，哮喘尤其非选择性药风险，不能突然停药。

supports.assessment: 比索洛尔疲劳头晕、呼吸问题告知、不自行停药；不将所有哮喘患者绝对禁用所有β阻滞剂。

text.zh-CN: 有哮喘等呼吸问题要告诉医生，便于选择药物。

text.en: Pneumonia is a lung infection that can also cause chest pain and breathlessness. Imaging provides clues, but local lung injury from PE can resemble pneumonia, so images are interpreted with the history.

text.en: Myocardial ischemia, meaning inadequate blood supply to heart muscle, or a heart attack can also cause chest pain and breathlessness. An ECG helps assess these cardiac causes; ECG changes alone do not confirm PE.

text.zh-CN: 气胸是空气进入肺外与胸壁之间的空隙，使肺受压，也可突然胸痛、气短。医生结合听诊和胸部影像判断；不能仅凭“吸气痛”区分气胸和肺栓塞。
text.en: Pneumothorax is air collecting between the lung and chest wall and compressing the lung. It can also cause sudden chest pain and breathlessness. Clinicians use examination and chest imaging; pain on breathing alone does not distinguish it from PE.

text.en: DVT occurs mainly in deep veins of the legs, pelvis or arms, whereas PE affects lung vessels. They may coexist, or only lung symptoms may be apparent. The chest-pain topic is a symptom entry point; this topic covers care for clot-related PE.

text.en: Anticoagulants slow clotting to limit clot growth and new clots while the body gradually deals with existing clots. The following describes common adult regimens; pregnancy, postpartum care and children need the additional assessment described under special populations.

text.en: Adult anticoagulation commonly continues for at least three months. Extension depends on persistent provoking factors, prior recurrence and bleeding risk. This is a common starting point in UK NICE guidance and US patient information, not an instruction to stop automatically at three months.

text.en: Warfarin requires regular clotting tests to assess its effect; other regimens may need kidney or liver tests to assess drug handling and safety. Follow the prescribing team’s monitoring plan rather than substituting symptom improvement for testing.

text.en: Some develop chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension, where residual obstruction and related changes cause persistently high pressure in lung vessels. Persistent exertional breathlessness needs assessment rather than being dismissed as poor fitness.

text.en: A child struggling to breathe, with clearly blue/grey skin or lips, not responding normally or difficult to wake, or having a seizure needs immediate emergency help. A very ill baby may not have a high fever.

supports.locator: When and where to get medical help / Immediate action required: baby or child under 5
supports.assessment: Direct support for the separately attributed UK under-five emergency action. Do not merge the two age criteria into a single jointly validated threshold.

text.zh-CN: 6月龄以下婴儿吃奶不正常或不醒来吃奶，应立即去医院，不必等到完全拒食；这是澳大利亚皇家儿童医院的就医建议。英国NHS建议，5岁以下孩子不进食或不吃奶、不能正常回应、比平时嗜睡或难以唤醒时，呼叫急救或直接急诊。
text.en: A baby under 6 months who is feeding poorly or not waking for feeds should go to hospital immediately, without waiting for complete refusal; this is the Australian Royal Children’s Hospital advice. UK NHS advice is to call emergency services or go to emergency care when a child under 5 is not feeding, not responding normally, sleepier than usual or difficult to wake.

text.zh-CN: 除上述婴幼儿和急救情形外，儿童饮水减少、呕吐后难以补充液体、湿尿布或排尿减少，应立即联系儿科或当地紧急医疗咨询评估。若明显萎靡、迅速变差或出现上述危险信号，直接去急诊。
text.en: Outside the infant and emergency situations above, a child drinking less, struggling to replace fluids after vomiting, or having fewer wet nappies/less urine needs prompt pediatric or local urgent medical advice. Marked lethargy, rapid deterioration or any of the warning signs above requires emergency assessment.

supports.locator: When to get help / See a doctor or health professional; Go to a hospital
supports.assessment: Reduced fluids or urine merits professional assessment; marked lethargy or rapid deterioration merits hospital. The preceding infant rule takes priority; vomiting is a hydration synthesis rather than a sepsis diagnostic threshold.
Reduced urine/wet nappies warrants urgent advice, while marked drowsiness, breathing or colour changes warrant emergency care. Does not establish a sepsis-specific vomiting threshold.

Repeated mental state, vitals/oxygen/urine and trends; same MSD group.

text.zh-CN: 医生会反复观察意识、血压、呼吸、血氧和排尿，判断供血和器官功能是否在变差；一次看起来正常，不代表之后不会变化。
text.en: Clinicians repeatedly assess awareness, blood pressure, breathing, oxygen and urine output to see whether circulation or organ function is worsening; an initially normal observation does not guarantee a stable course.

Conditional cultures and imaging.

text.zh-CN: 血液检查可评估感染反应、肝肾功能、凝血和氧供；尿液、伤口样本或胸腹部影像按症状和怀疑的感染部位选择，并非每个人都做同一套检查。
text.en: Blood tests assess the infection response, liver/kidney function, clotting and oxygen delivery. Urine or wound samples and chest/abdominal imaging are chosen for symptoms and suspected infection sites rather than using one identical test panel for everyone.

supports.assessment: No single test rules in/out adults.

supports.locator: Common questions / How do doctors diagnose sepsis?
supports.assessment: No single diagnostic test in children, exam/tests/reassessment.
Cultures seek pathogen; negative culture not exclusion.

text.zh-CN: 血培养是把血样中的病原体培养出来，帮助选择药物。单次指标或一次检测不能单独确诊或排除脓毒症，医生要结合查体、病程和后续变化。
text.en: Blood culture attempts to grow pathogens from a blood sample to help select medicines. A single marker or test cannot by itself confirm or exclude sepsis; examination, illness course and reassessment matter.

supports.assessment: Immediate treatment/resuscitation, adults only.
Immediate evaluation and treatment.
Urgent pediatric hospital care, fluids and other support; no adult dose transferred.

text.zh-CN: 疑似脓毒症的评估和治疗要同步推进。2026国际成人指南要求立即开始救治；儿童同样需要紧急评估，但补液和药物方案由儿科团队制定。
text.en: Evaluation and treatment of suspected sepsis proceed together. The 2026 international adult guideline calls for immediate treatment; children also need urgent assessment, with pediatric teams determining their fluid and medicine plan.

text.zh-CN: 意识混乱、心跳快、气短或低血压也可能来自非感染问题。医生会一边处理危险，一边核对感染来源和其他原因。
text.en: Confusion, a fast pulse, breathlessness or low blood pressure can also have noninfectious causes. Clinicians address immediate danger while checking infection sources and alternatives.

text.zh-CN: 严重脱水：大量呕吐、腹泻或饮水不足后，可能出现少尿、头晕、心跳快；严重时也会意识异常和休克。医生结合失水经过和检查判断，感染与脱水也可能同时存在。
text.en: Severe dehydration can follow heavy vomiting, diarrhoea or inadequate intake, causing reduced urine, dizziness and a fast pulse; severe cases can cause altered awareness and shock. Fluid-loss history and examination help assessment, and infection and dehydration may coexist.

supports.locator: Overview; Symptoms; When to see a doctor; Causes
supports.assessment: Exposure, throat swelling/breathing/fainting and no-wait emergency.
Anaphylaxis is a separate cause of shock.

supports.locator: Symptoms; Immediate action required; What to do if you have anaphylaxis; Causes
supports.assessment: Directly covers medicine/allergen-related throat/tongue swelling, breathing difficulty, wheeze, fainting/collapse and immediate emergency action. Hospital staff notification is the operational form of immediate help, not a separate treatment recommendation. NHS and Mayo are distinct editorial groups; independent acceptance remains pending.

text.zh-CN: 严重过敏反应：用药或接触过敏原后突然出现喉舌肿胀、喘鸣、呼吸困难或晕厥，是不同于感染的急症。发生这些表现立即急救，不等它自行消退。
text.en: Anaphylaxis is a different emergency: tongue/throat swelling, wheezing, breathing difficulty or fainting can occur suddenly after medicine or allergen exposure. Seek emergency help immediately rather than waiting for symptoms to settle.

supports.assessment: MI history/exam/ECG/biomarkers and sepsis-related ECG changes.
MI mechanism/context; same authoring group, not two sources.

text.zh-CN: 心肌梗死等心脏问题也会造成供血不足。医生可能结合胸痛等经过、心电图和心肌损伤血液指标区分；脓毒症本身也能影响心脏，不能只凭一个异常结果判定原因。
text.en: Heart problems such as myocardial infarction can also reduce blood flow. History including chest pain, an ECG and blood markers of heart injury may help distinguish causes; sepsis can itself affect the heart, so one abnormal result does not establish the cause.

supports.assessment: Re-evaluate and discontinue empiric treatment if alternative demonstrated/strongly suspected.

text.zh-CN: 如果后续证据显示不是感染，团队会重新判断是否继续抗感染药；这也是反复查体、复查结果和调整治疗的原因。
text.en: If later evidence points away from infection, the team reconsiders whether antimicrobials are still needed; this is why examination, results and treatment are reviewed repeatedly.

Abscess drainage/dead tissue removal; uncontrolled source worsens despite antibiotics.
Early adult source identification/control.

text.zh-CN: 抗感染药需要及时使用。脓肿（积聚的脓液）或坏死组织有时还要引流或手术清除，这叫“感染源控制”：仅靠药物可能不能处理持续释放病原体的部位。
text.en: Antimicrobials are given promptly. A pus collection (abscess) or dead tissue may also need drainage or surgical removal, called source control, because medicines alone may not resolve an ongoing infection source.

supports.locator: Treatment and recovery; Reducing risk / Patients
supports.assessment: Clinician choice of antibiotics and/or removal/change; necessity review.
Urinary catheters removed/changed if possible; narrowed to direct device example.

text.zh-CN: 若导尿管相关感染成为感染来源，医生可能需要拔除或更换导管，同时选择合适药物。由团队判断装置是否仍有必要及如何安全处理。
text.en: If a urinary-catheter infection is the source, clinicians may remove or replace the catheter and choose suitable medicines. The team determines whether the device is still needed and how to manage it safely.

supports.assessment: Fluids, vasopressors, ventilation/dialysis as needed.
Infection, circulation and organ support.

supports.locator: Fluid resuscitation; Vasopressors; Mechanical ventilation; Renal replacement therapy
supports.assessment: Adult organ support appropriate to clinical state, not universal procedures.

text.zh-CN: 静脉补液帮助恢复循环，仍低血压时可能用升压药。严重呼吸或肾功能问题可能需要呼吸机或透析，治疗强度由器官受损程度决定。
text.en: IV fluids support circulation and vasopressors may be needed for persistent low pressure. Severe respiratory or kidney dysfunction may require ventilation or dialysis, according to organ impairment.

text.en: Antimicrobials target pathogens, while fluids and vasopressors support circulation; their roles differ.

Broad initial antibiotic then specific choice.
Narrow when pathogen/susceptibility confirmed; culture-negative de-escalation also possible.
Selection by culture and sensitivity.

text.zh-CN: 起初可能使用覆盖多种细菌的抗生素，待感染来源、培养和药敏结果清楚后缩小范围；“药敏”是在检查中判断病原体对哪些药物敏感。
text.en: Initial antibiotics may cover several bacteria; the range can be narrowed when the source, cultures and susceptibility results are clear. Susceptibility testing checks which medicines the pathogen responds to.

supports.locator: Take antibiotics ONLY when needed / viruses
supports.assessment: Antibacterial-versus-virus boundary only.

supports.locator: Treating infections in people with cancer
supports.assessment: Anti-infective roles, cancer population only.
Adult suggestion against routine empirical antifungals; risks case by case. Not second support for all compound statement.

text.zh-CN: 抗细菌药不能杀灭病毒。需要抗病毒还是抗真菌药，要看实际病原体和病情；2026国际成人指南不建议给所有脓毒症患者常规加用抗真菌药。
text.en: Antibacterial drugs do not kill viruses. Antiviral or antifungal treatment depends on the pathogen and clinical situation; the 2026 international adult guideline advises against routine antifungal treatment for every patient with sepsis.

supports.assessment: No sharing/saving, delays and questions.
No leftovers/sharing and prescribed use; cites CDC, common guidance basis disclosed.

text.zh-CN: 不要用上次剩下的抗生素或别人的药自行处理这次感染；药物可能不对路，还会耽误适当治疗。出院处方按医嘱使用，有疑问联系医生或药师。
text.en: Do not self-treat this infection with leftover or another person’s antibiotics: the medicine may be inappropriate and delay suitable care. Follow the discharge prescription and ask a doctor or pharmacist about uncertainties.

supports.locator: Talk to provider about side effects
supports.assessment: Common effects, C. difficile severe diarrhoea and contact instruction.
Diarrhoea/nausea and provider contact; no specific second bowel-infection evidence.

text.zh-CN: 抗生素可能引起腹泻、恶心或皮疹。出现新的不良反应应联系治疗团队；严重腹泻尤其需要评估，因为有时与抗生素相关的肠道感染有关。
text.en: Antibiotics can cause diarrhoea, nausea or rash. Contact the treating team about new adverse effects; severe diarrhoea particularly needs assessment because it may reflect an antibiotic-associated bowel infection.

supports.locator: Symptoms; When to see a doctor; Causes

text.en: Marked breathing difficulty, throat/tongue swelling, wheezing or collapse after medication may be anaphylaxis: get emergency help immediately. In hospital alert staff at once; outside hospital call the local emergency service, without waiting for the next dose or routine review.

text.en: With coexisting chronic kidney disease, fluids and nutrients such as protein depend on kidney function and test results. text.en: Food does not replace antimicrobial treatment, fluids or organ support. During acute illness the hospital team plans nutrition according to factors such as whether feeding through the digestive tract is feasible.

text.zh-CN: 婴幼儿可能以喂养变差、反应减弱为主要表现，且不一定发高烧。尤其是6月龄以下婴儿，吃奶不正常或不醒来吃奶就应去医院；其他年龄与危险信号的行动见前面的分级说明。
text.en: Babies and young children may mainly show feeding or responsiveness changes and may not have a high fever. In particular, a baby under 6 months who is feeding poorly or not waking for feeds should go to hospital; see the earlier age-specific warning-sign actions for other situations.

text.zh-CN: 老人出现严重感染时可能没有明显高烧。痴呆或沟通困难者不容易表达不适，陪同者可以说明意识、活动和日常反应与平时有什么不同。
text.en: Older people with serious infection may not have a prominent fever. People with dementia or communication difficulties may struggle to describe illness; companions can explain how awareness, activity and usual responses have changed.

text.zh-CN: 化疗期间或因癌症治疗白细胞降低时，发热、寒战、新咳嗽、尿痛、伤口红肿等感染征象都要立即联系治疗团队或其值班服务；不要等到下一次门诊或等危险信号凑齐。
text.en: During chemotherapy or low white-cell counts from cancer treatment, fever, chills, new cough, painful urination or wound redness/swelling require immediate contact with the treating team or its on-call service. Do not wait for a routine visit or for all warning signs to appear.

text.zh-CN: 其他免疫抑制治疗的感染处理，要结合具体药物和开药团队的安排。例如，服用硫唑嘌呤时发生感染，要紧急咨询医生。英国NHS的风湿科资料建议：治疗期间出现发热、流感样症状或局部红肿热痛等感染征象，立即求医；轻微感冒或咳嗽持续或加重时联系医生。出现呼吸困难、意识异常等危险信号，直接急救。
text.en: Infection advice during other immunosuppressive treatment depends on the medicine and the prescribing team’s plan. For example, an infection while taking azathioprine requires urgent medical advice. UK NHS rheumatology advice calls for immediate medical advice for fever, flu-like illness or infection signs such as local redness, swelling, warmth or pain during treatment; contact a doctor if a mild cold or cough persists or worsens. Breathing difficulty, altered awareness or other emergency signs require emergency care directly.

text.zh-CN: 分娩后出现发热寒战、下腹痛或有异味的阴道分泌物，要立即联系产科或急诊评估感染；联系不上团队或身体明显恶化时直接去医院。孕期也不能把持续重度腹痛、呼吸困难或有异味的分泌物当作正常变化。
text.en: After delivery, fever/chills, lower abdominal pain or foul-smelling vaginal discharge require immediate obstetric or emergency assessment for infection; go directly to hospital if the team is unreachable or illness is clearly worsening. During pregnancy, persistent severe abdominal pain, breathing difficulty or foul-smelling discharge also should not be dismissed as normal changes.

text.zh-CN: 疑似脑膜炎需要立即医疗评估，不等出疹、发热或所有症状齐全。
text.en: Suspected meningitis needs immediate medical assessment; do not wait for a rash, fever or every symptom.

supports.locator: When and where to get help; You may not have all symptoms
supports.assessment: Emergency action and missing symptoms.

supports.locator: What is meningitis?; When should I see my doctor?
supports.assessment: Suspected disease is a medical emergency.

text.zh-CN: 新出现意识混乱、抽搐或难以唤醒，应立即呼叫当地急救电话或去急诊；即使没有发热也按此行动。
text.en: New confusion, seizures or difficulty waking require an immediate call to local emergency services or emergency care, even without fever.

supports.locator: When and where to get help: emergency symptom bullets
supports.assessment: Confusion, first seizure and hard-to-wake child are separate emergency triggers, not contingent on fever.

supports.locator: Symptoms; When should I see my doctor?
supports.assessment: Seizures, confusion and difficult waking combined with immediate ED/ambulance action.

text.zh-CN: 非常剧烈的头痛，或颈部僵硬并且看亮光疼痛，需要立即急诊评估。按压不褪色的紫红色皮疹也是危险信号；没有皮疹不能排除脑膜炎。
text.en: A very severe headache, or neck stiffness with pain on looking at bright light, needs immediate emergency assessment. A purple-red rash that does not fade under pressure is another warning sign; its absence does not exclude meningitis.

supports.locator: When and where to get help; Rash
supports.assessment: Severe headache, stiff neck/light pain, nonblanching rash and no-rash caution.

supports.locator: Symptoms; When should I see my doctor?
supports.assessment: Severe headache/neck-light symptoms, rash and immediate assessment.

text.zh-CN: 婴儿或幼儿出现反应差、身体松软、难唤醒、持续异常尖哭或头顶软处鼓起，尤其同时不肯吃奶时，应立即急诊评估。这些表现不要求同时出现。
text.en: An infant or young child who is poorly responsive, floppy, hard to wake, crying unusually and persistently, or has a bulging soft spot on the head needs immediate emergency assessment, especially with feeding refusal. These signs need not occur together.

supports.locator: Symptoms in babies/under 5; emergency advice for under 5
supports.assessment: Poor response, floppiness, difficult waking, abnormal cry and feeding changes.

supports.locator: Symptoms in young children and babies; When should I see my doctor?
supports.assessment: Includes bulging fontanelle and age-specific emergency care.

text.zh-CN: 尚未确诊、出现脑膜炎危险信号时，按上方急救行动处理；不要先把它当成普通头痛在家观察。
text.en: Before diagnosis, meningitis warning signs require the emergency action above rather than a period of home observation for an ordinary headache.

supports.locator: When and where to get help
supports.assessment: Immediate assessment for suspected disease.

supports.locator: When should I see my doctor?
supports.assessment: Emergency evaluation of meningitis symptoms.

text.zh-CN: 就诊准备提示：把症状开始时间、近期旅行或患者接触、接种记录、正在用的药和药物过敏告诉医疗团队；可由熟悉情况的亲友协助说明。这是帮助沟通的清单，不是诊断评分。
text.en: Visit preparation: tell the team when symptoms began, recent travel or ill contacts, vaccination history, current medicines and medicine allergies; a relative or friend who knows the situation can help. This is a communication checklist, not a diagnostic score.

supports.locator: Preparing for your appointment: What you can do; What to expect
supports.assessment: Direct preparation list; retained as explicitly editorial practical checklist, not a validated medical protocol.

text.zh-CN: 轻症病毒性病例可在医生评估后居家恢复；是否能回家取决于病情，而不是自己猜测病原体。
text.en: Mild viral cases may recover at home after clinical assessment; discharge depends on illness severity, not a guess about the pathogen.

supports.assessment: Mild viral home recovery after testing determines cause.

supports.locator: When to seek emergency care; Treatment and recovery
supports.assessment: Provider determines cause; severe/at-risk people may require hospital.

text.zh-CN: 居家期间若持续呕吐、连少量水也喝不下或喝了就吐，现在联系医生或急诊分诊服务，不能继续只靠喝水观察；伴意识变化或剧烈头痛时直接急诊。
text.en: During home recovery, ongoing vomiting with inability to drink even small amounts or keep water down requires contacting a clinician or urgent assessment service now; fluids alone are no longer enough. Altered awareness or severe headache requires emergency care.

supports.assessment: Persistent vomiting with no retained fluid: urgent advice now; confusion/severe headache: emergency.
For adults and over-12s: inability to keep water requires immediate doctor/ED; severe headache emergency.

supports.locator: When and where to get help
supports.assessment: Neurological emergency features in meningitis at any age.

text.zh-CN: 孩子喝不够水且越来越不舒服，或生病时停止吃奶，应现在联系医疗服务；出现身体松软、难唤醒或反应异常，按急救处理。
text.en: If a child cannot drink enough and is getting sicker, or stops feeding while ill, contact a medical service now. Floppiness, difficulty waking or abnormal responsiveness requires emergency care.

supports.locator: Key points; When to get help
supports.assessment: Insufficient intake with deterioration needs clinician; severe lethargy requires hospital.
Child stops breast/bottle feeding while ill.
Floppiness, difficult waking or abnormal responsiveness requires emergency action.

text.zh-CN: 检查的目标是确认是否存在脑膜炎并寻找病因，医生会结合病史、身体检查和检验结果判断。
text.en: The aim is to establish whether meningitis is present and identify its cause, using the history, examination and test results together.

supports.assessment: History, examination and tests.
Clinical features, blood and lumbar puncture results combined.

text.zh-CN: 腰椎穿刺是从腰部取少量脑脊液；脑脊液是包围脑和脊髓的液体。检测细胞数量、糖和蛋白质，并检查病原体，可帮助区分病因。
text.en: Lumbar puncture takes a small sample of cerebrospinal fluid from the lower back; this is the fluid surrounding the brain and spinal cord. Cell counts, sugar, protein and pathogen tests help distinguish causes.

supports.assessment: Fluid sampling, white cells/glucose/protein and pathogen testing.
CSF cell counts, protein, glucose, stain/culture and PCR.
Plain explanation of lumbar puncture and fluid location.

text.zh-CN: 血培养是观察血液样本能否长出细菌；PCR等分子检测寻找病原体的遗传物质。单一血液指标正常，仍不能独自排除细菌性脑膜炎。
text.en: Blood culture checks whether bacteria grow from a blood sample; molecular tests such as PCR look for pathogen genetic material. A single normal blood marker cannot by itself rule out bacterial meningitis.

supports.assessment: Culture and DNA-based PCR explanation; does not alone support exclusion rule.
Blood culture/PCR and explicit normal inflammatory marker limitation.

text.zh-CN: 部分患者需先稳定呼吸或循环，或因意识、神经检查异常而做脑部影像。医生评估腰穿是否安全；怀疑急性细菌性脑膜炎时，不能为了等影像、腰穿或结果而延误抗生素。
text.en: Some patients need breathing or circulation stabilised first, or brain imaging because of abnormal consciousness or neurological findings. Clinicians assess whether lumbar puncture is safe; suspected acute bacterial meningitis must not have antibiotics delayed while awaiting imaging, lumbar puncture or results.

supports.assessment: Stabilise listed compromise, selective imaging, antibiotics before imaging and no significant LP-related delay.
LP if possible but must not delay treatment; applies to suspected bacterial disease.

text.zh-CN: 早期脑膜炎可能像流感或胃肠炎，出现发热、呕吐和全身不适；症状重叠是需要检查的原因。
text.en: Early meningitis may resemble flu or gastroenteritis, with fever, vomiting and feeling unwell; this overlap is why assessment is needed.

supports.locator: Symptoms: early symptoms can be like flu, a stomach bug or a hangover
supports.assessment: Direct current NHS explanation of early overlap; not a diagnostic exclusion.

text.zh-CN: 偏头痛也可引起怕光、恶心、呕吐，甚至颈部不适。熟悉的偏头痛病史可帮助医生判断，但这些症状本身不能区分偏头痛与脑膜炎。
text.en: Migraine can also cause light sensitivity, nausea, vomiting and even neck discomfort. A familiar migraine history helps clinical assessment, but those symptoms alone do not distinguish migraine from meningitis.

supports.assessment: Migraine overlap including neck stiffness.
Same overlap; no symptom offered as stand-alone exclusion.
Meningitis overlapping symptoms and assessment.

text.zh-CN: 突然极重的头痛，或头痛伴新出现的抽搐、意识混乱、难唤醒，都需要急诊排查感染、出血或其他脑部急症；有偏头痛病史也一样。
text.en: A sudden extremely severe headache, or headache with a new seizure, confusion or difficulty waking, needs emergency assessment for infection, bleeding or another brain emergency, even with a history of migraine.

supports.assessment: Thunderclap, confusion/drowsiness and seizures warrant emergency care.
Thunderclap and neurological headache warning signs, even with headache history.

supports.locator: When and where to get help
supports.assessment: Meningitis warning signs requiring emergency assessment.

text.zh-CN: 脑膜炎不等于脑膜炎球菌病：多种病原体会引起脑膜炎；脑膜炎球菌也能进入血液，造成没有脑膜炎的血流感染和脓毒症。
text.en: Meningitis is not synonymous with meningococcal disease: many pathogens cause meningitis, while meningococci can enter the blood and cause bloodstream infection and sepsis without meningitis.

supports.assessment: Multiple causes; meningococcal disease is distinct.
Meningococcemia can occur without meningitis.
Meningococci can cause bloodstream infection or meningitis.

text.zh-CN: 治疗先处理可能迅速危及生命的情况，再按查明的病因调整。不同类型不能使用同一套疗程。
text.en: Treatment first addresses immediately dangerous illness and is then adjusted to the identified cause. Different types do not share one treatment course.

supports.assessment: Bacterial/viral/other types require different approaches.
Suspected bacterial treatment before final cause and cause-specific treatment.

text.zh-CN: 急性细菌性脑膜炎通常需要住院，尽快通过静脉给予抗生素；病原体尚未确定时先覆盖常见细菌，再按检查结果调整。
text.en: Acute bacterial meningitis usually requires hospital care and prompt intravenous antibiotics. Before the pathogen is known, treatment covers likely bacteria and is adjusted to test results.

supports.assessment: Immediate IV antibiotics and initial broad-spectrum treatment.
Bacterial meningitis treated in hospital with IV antibiotics.
Prompt antibiotics and early diagnostic assessment; empiric broad-spectrum choice is supported separately by Mayo.

text.zh-CN: 呼吸、循环或抽搐出现问题时，医院还会给予相应支持，例如需要时供氧、静脉补液和控制抽搐。处理这些问题与抗感染同时进行。
text.en: Breathing, circulation or seizure problems also need hospital support, such as oxygen when needed, intravenous fluids and seizure treatment, alongside treatment of the infection.

supports.assessment: IV fluids and oxygen if breathing difficulty.
Medicines to control seizures.
Antibiotics and stabilisation of breathing/shock/uncontrolled seizures; supports stabilisation but not every specific treatment technique.

text.zh-CN: 多数轻症病毒性病例以休息、补充液体和缓解疼痛发热为主；有严重病情或免疫功能低下等情况，可能仍需住院。
text.en: Most mild viral cases are managed with rest, fluids and relief of pain and fever; severe illness or weakened immunity may still require hospital care.

supports.assessment: Rest, fluids and symptom medicine.
Severe illness/high-risk groups may require hospital, including immune compromise.
Mild viral recovery at home after assessment.

text.zh-CN: 真菌性脑膜炎需要抗真菌药，具体药物和疗程取决于真菌种类及免疫状态，不按轻症病毒性病例处理。
text.en: Fungal meningitis needs antifungal medicines; the fungus and immune status determine the drugs and duration, rather than the approach for mild viral illness.

supports.assessment: Long antifungal courses dependent on immunity and type.
Antifungal treatment is distinct from viral care.
Antifungals and additional care according to fungal type.

text.zh-CN: 结核性脑膜炎由结核分枝杆菌引起，需要结核专科制定多药联合治疗。它不属于WHO急性脑膜炎指南所覆盖的常规急性病原体范围，也不能照搬普通肺结核或轻症病毒性脑膜炎的疗程。
text.en: Tuberculous meningitis is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and requires a TB specialist’s multidrug regimen. It is outside the routine acute pathogens covered by the WHO acute meningitis guideline, and treatment courses for uncomplicated pulmonary TB or mild viral meningitis cannot simply be copied.

supports.assessment: Specialist CNS treatment differs from non-CNS TB and depends on resistance.
Combined antibiotics for TB versus other meningitis treatments.
Explicit exclusion of TB and cryptococcal subacute/chronic meningitis; not evidence for their treatment.

text.en: Anti-infective medicines target different pathogens; clinicians also consider age, immune status, local resistance and medicine allergies.

supports.assessment: Age, immune status and local antibiotic resistance.

text.zh-CN: 抗生素能治疗细菌感染，不能清除引起病毒性脑膜炎的病毒；疱疹病毒等特定病因可能使用抗病毒药。
text.en: Antibiotics treat bacterial infection but do not clear the viruses causing viral meningitis; selected causes such as herpesviruses may be treated with antivirals.

supports.assessment: Antibiotic limitation and herpes antiviral treatment.
No general viral-specific treatment; selected herpes/influenza antiviral benefit.

text.zh-CN: 糖皮质激素是减轻炎症的辅助药，不替代抗生素。WHO建议在非流行期的适用急性细菌性病例中，与首剂抗生素一起开始；NICE对年龄和病原体另作规定，由医院决定，不能自行套用到所有脑膜炎。
text.en: Corticosteroids are adjuncts that reduce inflammation, not replacements for antibiotics. WHO recommends starting them with the first antibiotic dose in eligible acute bacterial cases outside epidemics; NICE adds age- and pathogen-specific rules. The hospital decides rather than applying steroids to every meningitis case.

supports.assessment: Non-epidemic setting; corticosteroid with first antibiotic.
Over-3-month use; specialist advice at 28 days–3 months; organism-specific continuation; never delay antibiotics.
Corticosteroid adjunct to antibiotics, reduction of inflammation/complications.

text.zh-CN: 抗生素偶可引起严重过敏。用药后出现呼吸困难、口唇舌头或喉咙肿胀，要立即呼叫急救；在医院内立即告知医护，不能等下一次常规复诊。
text.en: Antibiotics can occasionally cause severe allergy. Trouble breathing or swelling of the lips, tongue or throat after a dose requires emergency help immediately; in hospital alert staff at once, rather than waiting for routine follow-up.

supports.assessment: Antibiotics, airway symptoms and immediate emergency action.

supports.locator: Symptoms; When to see a doctor; Causes

text.en: Anti-TB medicines need adverse-effect surveillance: yellowing of the eyes or skin, or changes in vision, should be reported to the treatment team for assessment; the specific drug determines tests and treatment changes.

supports.assessment: Jaundice and vision changes require reporting/evaluation; hepatic/ocular toxicities vary by drug.

supports.assessment: Cause-directed medicines versus supportive fluids.
Food prevention, not treatment of established meningitis.

text.zh-CN: 医生同意在家恢复的轻症病毒性病例，可按耐受情况喝水、进食；恶心时尝试少量多次。若连少量水也留不住，按“何时就医”的即时联系安排处理。
text.en: For mild viral illness cleared for home recovery, drink and eat as tolerated, trying small amounts when nauseated. If even small amounts of water cannot be retained, use the immediate medical-contact advice under “When to seek care”.

supports.assessment: Fluid support for mild viral disease.

text.zh-CN: 孕妇、老年人和免疫功能低下者尤其要减少李斯特菌暴露：选择巴氏消毒奶，避免生奶和生奶制品。巴氏消毒是通过加热减少有害细菌的处理。
text.en: Pregnant people, older adults and people with weakened immunity especially need to reduce Listeria exposure: choose pasteurized milk and avoid raw milk and raw-milk products. Pasteurization uses heat to reduce harmful bacteria.

text.zh-CN: 奶酪要分类型：用巴氏消毒奶制成的硬奶酪通常是较安全的选择；queso fresco、queso blanco、requesón这类鲜软奶酪，即使用巴氏消毒奶制作，也应避免未加热食用。
text.en: Cheese type matters: hard cheese made with pasteurized milk is generally a safer choice; queso fresco-type fresh soft cheeses, including queso blanco and requesón, should not be eaten unheated even when made with pasteurized milk.

text.en: Ready-to-eat deli meats and hot dogs are not automatically safe straight from the packet; people in the groups above should reheat them until steaming hot throughout. Refrigeration does not reliably eliminate Listeria.

supports.assessment: Reheat until steaming hot.

text.en: Home care applies to people assessed and cleared to go home; seek help again if emergency signs develop.

text.zh-CN: 按出院安排休息和使用缓解症状的药物。可简单记下头痛是否加重、喝水和呕吐情况、清醒程度，方便向医护说明变化；这不是在家排除脑膜炎的评分表。
text.en: Follow the discharge plan for rest and symptom medicines. A simple note of worsening headache, drinking/vomiting and alertness can help you describe changes to staff; it is not a home score for ruling out meningitis.

supports.locator: Viral meningitis; Preparing for your appointment
supports.assessment: Rest/symptom medicines and notes on symptoms/cognition; exact practical diary format is editorial synthesis.

supports.locator: Treatment; When and where to get help
supports.assessment: Rest/symptom relief and warning changes, not validation of a diary.

text.zh-CN: 认真洗手，不共用杯子、餐具等接触唾液的物品，可减少相关病原体传播；具体隔离和接触者处理由病因决定。
text.en: Wash hands carefully and avoid sharing cups or cutlery that contact saliva to reduce spread of relevant pathogens; the cause determines isolation and contact management.

supports.assessment: Handwashing and avoiding shared utensils.
Handwashing and no shared cups/cutlery; meningococcal contact prevention.

text.zh-CN: 离院前把后续就诊地点、联系人和听力评估安排记清楚；若出院后出现新的难唤醒、抽搐或意识混乱，不等预约日期，立即急救。
text.en: Before leaving, note the follow-up location, contact person and hearing-assessment arrangements. New difficulty waking, seizures or confusion after discharge require emergency help without waiting for the appointment.

supports.assessment: Audiology and documented discharge follow-up/contact arrangements.
Give place/time for audiology follow-up before leaving.

supports.assessment: Neurological emergency triggers, including after prior assessment.

text.zh-CN: 年龄和免疫状态会改变常见病原体、症状表达与处理方式。
text.en: Age and immune status change the likely pathogens, how symptoms are expressed and the care needed.

supports.locator: Who is at risk; Signs and symptoms; Treatment
supports.assessment: Risk, manifestations and treatment differ by age/immunity.
Age and medical-condition differences.

text.zh-CN: 婴儿可能没有典型颈部僵硬，也无法诉说头痛，反而表现为吃奶差、异常哭声、反应变差或头顶软处鼓起。新生儿需要按新生儿感染路径评估，不能直接套用较大儿童或成人的方案。
text.en: Infants may lack classic neck stiffness and cannot describe headache; poor feeding, an unusual cry, reduced responsiveness or a bulging soft spot may be the clues. Newborns need a neonatal-infection assessment rather than direct use of an older-child or adult regimen.

supports.assessment: Absent typical adult symptoms and infant signs.
Infant/newborn manifestations.
Neonates excluded from acute guideline; neonatal pathway statement is a scope boundary, not a neonatal treatment protocol.

text.zh-CN: 化疗、移植后用药或HIV等造成免疫功能低下时，真菌感染等病因更值得考虑；把这些情况告知团队，有助选择针对性的检查和治疗。
text.en: Chemotherapy, transplant medicines or HIV can weaken immunity and make causes such as fungal infection more relevant; tell the team about them to guide targeted testing and treatment.

supports.assessment: HIV, immunosuppressive drugs/conditions and fungal risk.

supports.locator: Risk factors: Compromised immune system; Fungal meningitis
supports.assessment: Immune compromise and fungal risk.

supports.locator: What to expect from your doctor
supports.assessment: Report immunosuppressing medicines and other health concerns.

text.zh-CN: 妊娠会增加李斯特菌感染风险；母亲症状可能较轻，但感染可影响胎儿或新生儿。就医时说明妊娠情况，并按本页食安建议选择食物。
text.en: Pregnancy raises Listeria risk; maternal symptoms can be mild while infection harms the fetus or newborn. Tell the team about pregnancy and use the food-safety advice on this page.

text.zh-CN: 预后取决于病因、治疗时机及是否出现神经并发症。
text.en: Outcome depends on cause, treatment timing and neurological complications.

supports.assessment: Sequelae and treatment importance.
Sequelae and prompt treatment.

text.zh-CN: 多数轻症病毒性病例可逐渐恢复；细菌性、结核性和真菌性不能沿用同一恢复时间表。真菌性病例的疗程还与免疫状态有关。
text.en: Most mild viral cases recover gradually; bacterial, tuberculous and fungal disease do not share one recovery timeline. Immune status also affects the duration of antifungal treatment.

supports.assessment: Mild viral recovery and severe-case exceptions.
Immune-dependent fungal treatment length.
Distinct specialist CNS TB course.
Cause-based course and therapies.

text.zh-CN: 听力检查要主动安排，尤其细菌性脑膜炎之后，不能等到本人或家长察觉听不清才检查。正式听力评估由听力专业人员完成，不是只在家试声音。
text.en: Hearing assessment should be planned proactively, especially after bacterial meningitis, rather than waiting for the person or family to notice hearing loss. Formal audiological assessment is a professional test, not only a home sound check.

supports.locator: C.4 Hearing loss: recommendation and implementation
supports.assessment: Formal screening for acute meningitis; proactive scheduling.
Offer formal audiological assessment after bacterial meningitis/meningococcal disease.

text.zh-CN: 时间按适用指南核对：WHO对其急性社区获得性脑膜炎范围内的1月龄以上儿童和成人，建议出院前正式听力筛查，不能完成时在出院后4周内完成；英国NICE针对细菌性脑膜炎或脑膜炎球菌病，建议身体状况允许测试后4周内完成，最好出院前。两个起算点不同。
text.en: Check the applicable timing: for children over 1 month and adults within its acute community-acquired meningitis scope, WHO recommends formal hearing screening before discharge, or within 4 weeks after discharge if that is not possible. UK NICE recommends assessment after bacterial meningitis or meningococcal disease within 4 weeks of being well enough for testing, preferably before discharge. These are different starting points.

supports.assessment: Only WHO population and discharge-based timing; not support for NICE anchor.
Only NICE bacterial/meningococcal scope and fit-for-testing timing; not support for WHO anchor.

text.zh-CN: WHO把及时听力筛查列为强建议，但证据确定性很低，主要依据间接证据和专家判断；这不等于精确时点已由高质量对照试验证实。
text.en: WHO makes a strong recommendation for timely hearing screening despite very low certainty of evidence, relying mainly on indirect evidence and expert judgement; this does not mean the exact timing has been established by high-quality comparative trials.

supports.locator: C.4 Hearing loss: Strong recommendation; Justification
supports.assessment: Explicit very-low-certainty grade and absence of comparative studies.

text.zh-CN: 复诊还应关注视力、记忆学习、活动和心理状态，出现困难时安排相应评估与康复；新出现意识混乱、抽搐或难唤醒按急救处理。
text.en: Follow-up also considers vision, memory/learning, movement and psychological wellbeing, with assessment and rehabilitation for difficulties; new confusion, seizures or difficulty waking require emergency care.

supports.assessment: Multidisciplinary follow-up, neurological/developmental and psychosocial needs.
Visual, neurological and psychosocial sequelae and long-term support.

supports.assessment: Recovery issues and immediate neurological danger.

text.en: Complications can occur during the acute illness or become apparent after infection is controlled.

supports.assessment: Acute and longer-term complications.
Neurological and other sequelae.

text.zh-CN: 急性期可出现抽搐、脑功能受损、脓毒症或休克，严重时危及生命；及时治疗有助降低风险。
text.en: Acute seizures, brain dysfunction, sepsis or shock can be life-threatening; prompt treatment helps reduce risk.

supports.assessment: Serious bacterial outcomes and prompt therapy.
Seizures, brain damage, shock and death.
Acute complications and treatment importance.

text.zh-CN: 部分患者留有听力或视力下降、记忆学习困难、肢体无力等后遗症；并非所有患者都会发生，实际变化决定需要哪些支持。
text.en: Some survivors have hearing or vision loss, memory/learning difficulties or limb weakness; these do not affect everyone, and actual changes determine support needs.

supports.assessment: Hearing/vision, cognitive and motor consequences.
Hearing, vision, coordination and memory difficulties.
Neurological sequelae.

text.zh-CN: 主动脉是把血从心脏送往全身的大血管。主动脉夹层是血管内层撕开，血液钻入血管壁层间，把原本贴合的层分开。

text.zh-CN: 心肌梗死是心肌供血不足造成损伤，夹层是主动脉壁受损；夹层也可能影响冠状动脉供血。因此一次胸痛描述不能决定治疗。
text.en: Myocardial infarction is injury from inadequate blood supply to heart muscle; dissection is injury within the aortic wall. Dissection can itself impair coronary flow, so the pain description alone cannot determine treatment.

text.en: An aortic aneurysm may remain symptomless for a long time. Rupture means blood escapes through the vessel wall. Dissection, aneurysm and rupture are distinct but can all require emergency vascular assessment.

text.zh-CN: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒，简称DKA，是胰岛素不足引起的急性危象：身体难以利用血糖，转而大量分解脂肪，产生过多称为“酮体”的酸性物质。
text.en: Diabetic ketoacidosis, or DKA, is an acute crisis caused by insufficient insulin. The body cannot use glucose effectively and breaks down large amounts of fat, producing excess acids called ketones.

text.zh-CN: 酮体使血液变酸，尿多和呕吐又会造成水分及矿物质丢失。人可能从口渴、疲倦发展到深快呼吸、腹痛和意识异常。
text.en: Ketones make the blood acidic, while frequent urination and vomiting deplete water and minerals. Thirst and fatigue can progress to deep rapid breathing, abdominal pain and altered awareness.

text.zh-CN: 一氧化碳，简称CO，是燃料燃烧时可能产生的无色、无味气体。吸入后它会妨碍血液携带和释放氧，也影响细胞利用氧，使脑和心脏等器官受损。
text.en: Carbon monoxide, or CO, is a colorless, odorless gas that can be produced by burning fuel. It interferes with blood carrying and releasing oxygen and with cells using oxygen, damaging organs such as the brain and heart.
